content.text:
Two wakeups at 19 months is common but usually fixable by stretching the gap between naps and capping the afternoon sleep, so Remy builds enough sleep pressure to stay down. When he wakes, try a brief, boring check-in — same words, no lights, no feed — so the night stops being interesting.
